snippet.title: WildRoot - Cozy Colony Sim | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
WildRoot is a cozy colony simulation game where you guide a small group of settlers as they build a new life in the wilderness.

Gather resources, construct shelters, farm crops, cook meals, craft useful items, hunt wildlife, and manage your colonists' daily tasks. Watch your colony grow from a small camp into a thriving settlement while surviving the challenges of the changing seasons.

Features:
• Colony management
• Farming and cooking
• Building and crafting
• Wildlife and hunting
• Dynamic seasons
• Relaxing low-poly art style

Follow development for future updates!
